events.title: Treaty of Picquigny Ends the Hundred Years' War
events.description: England's Edward IV and France's Louis XI agreed to the Treaty of Picquigny. It formally ended the long conflict between the two kingdoms. Under the deal, Edward withdrew his army from France in return for a large payment and an annual pension.
events.significance: The treaty closed the final chapter of the Hundred Years' War. It marked the end of England's large-scale attempts to conquer France.

events.title: Louis II of Hungary Dies After the Battle of Mohács
events.description: Louis II, the last Jagiellonian king of Hungary and Bohemia, died after his army was crushed by Ottoman forces led by Suleiman the Magnificent. He was still a young man when he fell.
events.significance: The defeat shattered the medieval Kingdom of Hungary. It opened the way for Ottoman expansion in Central Europe and for Habsburg rule over Hungary and Bohemia.

events.title: Faraday Discovers Electromagnetic Induction
events.description: The English scientist Michael Faraday showed that changing a magnetic field can produce an electric current in a nearby circuit. He did this in experiments at the Royal Institution in London.
events.significance: The discovery of electromagnetic induction is the basis of electric generators and transformers. It underpins modern power generation.

events.title: Treaty of Nanking Ends the First Opium War
events.description: Representatives of Britain and Qing China signed the Treaty of Nanking aboard a British warship. China ceded Hong Kong Island to Britain and opened five ports to foreign trade. It also agreed to pay an indemnity.
events.significance: The treaty is often seen as the start of China's "century of humiliation". It set the pattern for later unequal treaties between China and Western powers.

events.title: Daimler Patents the First Motorcycle
events.description: German engineer Gottlieb Daimler patented a wooden-framed two-wheeled vehicle powered by a small internal combustion engine. It is regarded as the world's first motorcycle.
events.significance: The machine showed that compact gasoline engines could power personal transport. It was an early step toward both motorcycles and automobiles.
